goal: Decide if a block header's hash meets its target, so any node can check the proof of work from the header alone.

app.name: header-work
limits: The hash and target are compared by their leading zero bits, then by the rest of the hash; decoding the compact bits to a target is the caller's.
It does not search nonces; prism-btc-node does.
app.title: Header work
app.purpose: Decide whether a block header is accepted, from the leading zero bits of its double SHA-256 hash, the leading zero bits of its target, and how the rest of the hash compares with the target when those are equal.

fields.name: zeros
fields.means: leading zero bits of the header's sha256d hash

fields.name: target
fields.means: leading zero bits of the target the compact bits decode to

fields.name: rest
fields.means: with equal leading zeros, the rest of the hash against the rest of the target

meanings.accepted: block_hash <= target: the header carries the work
meanings.rejected: block_hash > target: the candidate does not admit

rules.why: ARCHITECTURE.md: admission is block_hash <= target compared as bytes (LexicographicLessEqThreshold); more leading zeros is smaller
crates/prism-btc-node/src/lib.rs scan_template_nonces: fewer leading zeros is above the target, so the nonce is not taken
ARCHITECTURE.md: with an equal zero prefix the remaining bytes decide, and above the target does not admit

app.otherwiseWhy: the rest is lower than or tied with the target: block_hash <= target admits

properties.why: a header without the work is never accepted
more leading zeros than the target always admits
a hash above the target never admits

stakeholders.name: Node operator
stakeholders.text: Runs a node and needs every accepted header to carry the work its target requires.

stakeholders.name: Miner
stakeholders.text: Runs prism-btc-node's nonce scan and needs a header it submits to be one Bitcoin Core accepts.

concerns.name: Agreement with Bitcoin Core
concerns.text: The admission is Bitcoin's own block_hash <= target, so a header the app accepts is one submitblock accepts.

components.name: Bitcoin Core
components.text: The Bitcoin Core node prism-btc-node talks to over RPC: getblocktemplate for templates, submitblock for admitted headers.

components.name: prism-btc-wasm
components.text: The WebAssembly binding of the prism-btc kernel, crates/prism-btc-wasm.

threats.name: Header accepted without work
threats.text: A header whose hash is above its target is accepted and relayed.

control.name: Work proved
control.text: The app never accepts fewer leading zeros than the target, and the node takes a nonce only when target.is_satisfied_by_bytes(digest).

threats.name: Target misdecoded
threats.text: The compact bits are decoded to an easier target, so a header passes with less work.
threats.accepted: The app compares the zero counts it is given; decoding Bits to Target belongs to the caller, and Bitcoin Core re-checks every submitted block.

threats.name: Nonce space exhausted
threats.text: No nonce of a template admits, so mining stalls.
threats.accepted: prism-btc-node rolls the extranonce when the 32-bit nonce space is exhausted; the app answers each candidate on its own.

quality.text: Every header the app accepts is one Bitcoin Core accepts by work, and every one it rejects is one Core rejects.
quality.measureText: Examples whose answer differs from block_hash <= target.
